I still have this doubts:
1. What happens when a minion steals more blood than the opposing minion
has?
Does the opposing minion goes into torpor, is burned or stays with no blood?

2. Can a minion steal blood from another minion with no blood on him?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Luis P. Duarte wrote:
>
> I still have this doubts:
> 1. What happens when a minion steals more blood than the opposing minion has?
> Does the opposing minion goes into torpor, is burned or stays with no blood?

Attempting to steal more blood from an opponent than he has results in
merely stealing all of his reminaing blood - the excess "steal" is ignored.
The victim is left empty, but is not burned or sent to torpor.

> 2. Can a minion steal blood from another minion with no blood on him?

Sure, and the amount stolen will be zero (see above).
